question: A police officer sees a thief from 200 meters. The thief flees, and the police officer pursues him. The thief and the police are both running at 10 km/h and 11 km/h, respectively. At what distance will the police apprehend the thief?
solution:
Given:

Distance = 200 m

Speed of the policeman = 11 km/h

Speed of the thief = 10 km/h

Formula Used :

(i) Distance = Speed × Time

Calculations:

Let the time be t.

According to the Question,

Distance covered by thief in t time + 200 m = Distance travelled by Police in same time 

⇒ 10t + 200/1000 km = 11t

⇒ 11t - 10t = 0.2

⇒ t = 0.2 hours

⇒ Distance = 11(t) = 11(0.2) = 2.2 Km

Hence, The thief will have run 2.2 Km before he is overtaken by the policeman.
